newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CESC Ltd raises $15 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: India's CESC Ltd raises $15 mln loan.

text.p: Citibank International Plc concluded a $15 million loan for Indian power utility firm CESC Ltd, the Bombay office of Citibank NA said on Friday.

"The loan is structured with a bullet repayment of three years and was arranged to finance a part of the 4.0 billion rolling capital expenditure programme primarily dedicated towards strengthening the company's downstream transmission and distribution network," a Citibank statement said.
The syndicated offering was oversubscribed, it said.
